supersedes: market_valuation_breadth_v1, which is technically invalid with zero aligned rows and no forecast evidence
v2_only_change: Remove yield_valid_fraction because unlabeled source diagnostics prove it is exactly 1.0 on all 5,088 dates and has zero causal rolling standard deviation on all 4,963 post-warmup dates.
hypothesis: The point-in-time cross-sectional distribution of PER, PBR and dividend yield measures internal market valuation constitution and adds stable 20-trading-day TWII direction beyond index trend and aggregate FinMind positioning.
decision_time: After date-t cash close and publication of date-t TaiwanStockPER values.
target: TWII close direction from date t to 20 actual Taiwan cash-market trading days later.

data_semantics.point_in_time_universe: Four-digit common stocks present on that source date; no current constituent list.
data_semantics.per_policy: Only finite positive PER values enter PER distribution statistics; nonpositive PER remains represented through the valid fraction.
data_semantics.pbr_policy: Only finite positive PBR values enter PBR distribution statistics; invalid values remain represented through the valid fraction.
data_semantics.yield_policy: Finite nonnegative dividend yields enter yield median and high-yield breadth. The constant valid-yield fraction is excluded.
data_semantics.raw_persistence: Raw security rows are reduced to one immutable daily aggregate row and are not retained.

features: median and IQR of log positive PER
fractions of positive PER below 10 and above 30
median and IQR of log positive PBR
fraction of valid yields at least 4
feature_transform: Each of the 12 nonconstant fixed daily aggregates is converted to a causal 252-row rolling z-score with at least 126 contemporaneous/past observations. No future value enters a transform.
method: 1512/252/252 nested ridge-abstention, 20-row purge at fit/validation boundaries, frozen lambda and confidence threshold for each following test block, and effective origins separated by at least 20 actual TWII rows.
formal_run_policy: Execute exactly once after this v2 manifest. No result-dependent feature, threshold, date, horizon, subgroup or baseline changes are allowed.
promotion_policy: The valuation treatment must pass every absolute gate, significantly beat the strongest simple baseline on identical dates, and significantly beat the index/aggregate control on common dates. Otherwise every valuation directional coefficient remains zero.
